images.subject: Jackie Potts (starter, bored Minx), Common 'streetwalker': resting look
images.use: Main portrait (resting); character select; Common tier
images.prompt: Glossy 1980s airbrush illustration fused with modern Las Vegas nightlife photography, synthwave and cyberpunk-glam key art, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp detail. Waist-up character portrait, vertical composition, head and shoulders large in the frame, face in the upper third. Jackie Potts, an adult woman in her mid-thirties, a tired, lived-in, worldly face with faint crow's feet and laugh lines, heavy-lidded hazel eyes, black winged eyeliner a little worn at the edges, platinum-blonde hair with dark roots scraped into a messy high ponytail, a small beauty spot on her left cheekbone. Wardrobe level: shabby. She wears last night's crumpled silver sequinned minidress with thin straps and a high straight neckline across her collarbones, a white towelling hotel robe slipping off one bare shoulder, oversized white sunglasses pushed up into her hair and laddered black tights; her opaque outfit fully covers her chest and hips. Expression: deadpan boredom: heavy-lidded half-closed eyes, a relaxed brow, a flat unimpressed mouth, not sad, just thoroughly bored. Setting: leaning on a lamp post on an empty wet Las Vegas street at four in the morning, holding a smartphone with a cracked dark screen at her hip, the background a soft blur of neon bokeh with one wordless neon palm-tree outline, puddles reflecting magenta and cyan. Hard hot-magenta and electric-cyan neon rim light, chrome reflections, glossy airbrushed highlights, deep indigo night shadows, a little sparkle of casino glitz. Colour palette of midnight indigo, deep plum, hot magenta, electric cyan, violet, chrome silver and gold-chrome highlights. Full-bleed illustration, no frame, no border. No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos anywhere; any neon sign is a wordless shape.
images.notes: v2: sequinned minidress as content.js says, hotel robe slipping off one shoulder, neckline low but covered, bored; review finding 27
